decision_rule: Model-free target-mark parser qualification: accept only if the source and r5 binary match the build receipt and two fixture tests pass, including all ten missing, duplicate, ordering, step, frequency, timestamp, malformed and clock-error mutations. Stop on source drift, failed controls, STOP or deadline. This validates only the format/parser for the source-bound target; no live alignment, drift, GPU, inference, or attribution follows.
notes: Source and binary pinned to completed r5 build receipt; synthetic qualification only. Fresh target witness, trace and residency custody and validated drift remain required.
